_readme: Hand-written evaluations merged into components.json by scripts/refresh.mjs. 'families' keys are '<source>/<family>' and apply to every item in that family; 'items' keys are '<source>/<key>' and override. Fields: status (used|adopted|candidate|rejected), surface (app|marketing|both), motion (none|decorative|guard), note. 'guard' = needs a prefers-reduced-motion guard before use. Record why in note: where it was used, or why it was rejected. No project names: this file ships publicly.

ui-layouts/text-animation.note: Marquee and blur-in word reveals. Pause/stop under reduced motion; keep decorative text aria-hidden. Used for: landing page: tagline marquee, scroll-text headlines; landing H1 word-by-word reveal. Split by word, never by letter (Persian shaping).

ui-layouts/spotlight-cards.note: Cursor-follow glow. Decoration only, never the sole hover affordance. Used for: landing page: privacy points, stat cards; landing bento tiles and brand-guide value cards; static glow on slide-content cards.

ui-layouts/animated-beam.note: SVG beams between nodes. Good for 'one to many' diagrams. Give the diagram role=img and a label. Used for: landing page: presenter to viewers; landing and login diagrams (CSS dashoffset, no JS).

ui-layouts/motion-number.note: Counting numbers. Render the final value when motion is reduced. Used for: landing page: stat cards; landing stats counters (@property + counter()).

ui-layouts/marquee.note: Horizontal and vertical marquees. Duplicate content for the loop, aria-hidden on the copy. Used for: landing page: hero chat column; landing values band; static mid-scroll band on the Instagram post.

ui-layouts/image-reveal.note: Used for: landing page: hero mock window.

ui-layouts/bg-blocks.note: Used for: landing page: hero grid background.

ui-layouts/noise-effect.note: Grain overlay (feTurbulence). Keep opacity low so text contrast holds. Used for: landing page: hero panel; landing hero and values band, login ground.

ui-layouts/liquid-gradient.note: Animated gradient buttons. Pick stops that keep white text at 4.5:1 across the whole gradient. Used for: landing page: Download CTA.

ui-layouts/footers.note: Used for: landing page: giant wordmark footer.

ui-layouts/scroll-animation.note: Scroll reveals. CSS animation-timeline: view() works without JS; fall back to visible. Used for: landing page: section fade-up.

ui-layouts/accordion.note: Prefer native <details> for plain FAQs; image accordions need button semantics so they work by keyboard. Used for: landing page: room features, FAQ.

ui-layouts/carousel.note: Embla-based. Needs real prev/next buttons and no autoplay without a pause control.

ui-layouts/swapy.note: Rejected because: drag-reorder has no use case; keyboard story is weak.

ui-layouts/liquid-glass.note: Rejected because: glass effects clash with the flat dark look and hurt text contrast; glass over text hurts contrast; login card uses a solid fill with a gradient border instead.

ui-layouts/hero-section.note: Block family traits (reviewed 2026-10-02): every block needs `motion` plus a shared timeline-animation.tsx (useInView only, no reduced-motion guard: patch it once and all blocks inherit the fix). Copy, brand names, stats and images (unsplash/picsum) are placeholders to replace. Light/dark and fonts are hardcoded Tailwind classes: re-skin to project tokens.

ui-layouts/mousetrail.note: Rejected because: heavy motion, no content to show; cursor trails distract from content and do nothing on touch.

react-bits/text-animations.note: Hero and headline text effects. Split by word for Persian/Arabic, never by letter (shaping breaks). Keep real text in the DOM for screen readers. Gimmick-grade effects (ASCII, particle, glitch, falling text, cursor trails, WebGL backdrops) look premium in a demo but cost attention, GPU and contrast in product UI; use sparingly and only where the page already earns a moment.  Install pulls the TS+Tailwind variant; map colours to project tokens.

react-bits/animations.note: Wrappers, scroll reveals, borders, cursors. Cursor effects are decoration only, never the sole affordance, and are off on touch. Gimmick-grade effects (ASCII, particle, glitch, falling text, cursor trails, WebGL backdrops) look premium in a demo but cost attention, GPU and contrast in product UI; use sparingly and only where the page already earns a moment.  Install pulls the TS+Tailwind variant; map colours to project tokens.

react-bits/components.note: Cards, menus, galleries, sliders. Many are image-gallery or marketing patterns; check keyboard and focus before using in product UI. Install pulls the TS+Tailwind variant; map colours to project tokens.

react-bits/micro.note: Small interaction components (toggles, buttons, inputs, toasts, agent/chat status). Closest to product UI; verify focus, labels and reduced-motion on each. Install pulls the TS+Tailwind variant; map colours to project tokens.

react-bits/backgrounds.note: Full-bleed WebGL/canvas backgrounds for hero or empty states. Needs a static fallback under reduced motion, contrast check against text on top, and a mobile performance check. Many pull in ogl or three. Install pulls the TS+Tailwind variant; map colours to project tokens.

ui-layouts/stats-banner.note: Stat banner over a photo (unsplash); needs a mock instead of a photo.

ui-layouts/stats-bento.note: 6-col bento of stats (market share, reviews); review-score style content is not applicable to a pre-launch product.

ui-layouts/advanced-stats.note: Dashboard-style revenue/subscription stats with charts; not a marketing block. Rejected because: dashboard content.

ui-layouts/faq-minimilastic.note: Accordion (component, accessible semantics) plus a closing "Still have questions?" call to action. Best default FAQ block.

ui-layouts/faq-tabbed-explorer.note: Tabs plus accordion; only worth it with 10+ questions grouped by topic.

ui-layouts/faq-interactive-preview.note: Accordion with a preview image per answer. Opens on onMouseEnter (hover only), so add focus and click handling before use.

ui-layouts/faq-glass-card.note: Glass card over a photo background; contrast risk. Rejected because: glass and photo background hurt contrast.

ui-layouts/faq-founder.note: Founder portrait and LinkedIn link beside the FAQ; not applicable. Rejected because: founder-led layout.
